event_order: Atomic event batch: remove obligations ending at t, add obligations beginning at t; preserve continuous-position one-sided-limit compatibility as separate junction obligation.
contact_validation: True clipped pulp-face/top intersection and area; not distance tolerance alone; penetration and anatomy independently enforced.
boundary_compatibility: A continuous trajectory must reconcile left/right contact sets and position/velocity limits. Half-open labels do not permit teleportation or prove junction existence.
free_motion: No active contacts permits whole-hand motion only under anatomy, all-key collision and travel-time constraints.
sliding: Material witness may migrate only within verified actual pulp/playable patch; tangential displacement/velocity budget is explicit planner parameter. Sticking is a valid stricter adapter specialization.
